text: {"contradictions":[{"source":"སྟོང་པ་ཉིད་དེ་ལ་གཟུགས་ཡོད་པར་གཟུགས་ལ་འགྱུར་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་ཐ་ཚིག་གོ།","english":"If emptiness does not exist, the meaning of the phrase \"form would exist within it\" is expressed as \"it would transform into form.\"","kind":"sense","why":"The source says 'if it [the object] does not exist, then [the phrase] \"form exists in emptiness\" means it transforms into form', but the English makes emptiness itself non-existent.","certainty":"high"},{"source":"ཆོས་ཐམས་ཅད་གཉིས་ཀྱི་སྒོ་ནས་བསྩལ་བའི་འགྲེས་","english":"The category of analyzing all phenomena through the gate of duality.","kind":"sense","why":"The source says 'duality' (gnyis), but in this context of emptiness/non-perception, it likely refers to the 'two' (as in two truths or two extremes), whereas 'duality' implies a binary opposition.","certainty":"medium"}],"omissions":[],"additions":[]}

contradictions.english: If emptiness does not exist, the meaning of the phrase "form would exist within it" is expressed as "it would transform into form."
contradictions.why: The source says 'if it [the object] does not exist, then [the phrase] "form exists in emptiness" means it transforms into form', but the English makes emptiness itself non-existent.

contradictions.english: The category of analyzing all phenomena through the gate of duality.
contradictions.why: The source says 'duality' (gnyis), but in this context of emptiness/non-perception, it likely refers to the 'two' (as in two truths or two extremes), whereas 'duality' implies a binary opposition.
